# Database Schema

This collection stores all the courses created by users. Each document represents a single course with its details, duration, and status.

## `courses` Collection
```json
{
  "_id": "string (auto-generated by Cloud Database)",
  "userId": "string (OpenID of the user who created the course)",
  "title": "string (Name/Title of the course)",
  "description": "string (Detailed description of the course)",
  "instructor": "string (Name of the instructor, optional)",
  "courseCycleDays": "number (e.g., 10, 15, 30 days)",
  "startDate": "timestamp (ISO 8601 string or Date object, chosen by user)",
  "endDate": "timestamp (ISO 8601 string or Date object, calculated: startDate + courseCycleDays)",
  "status": "string (e.g., 'active', 'completed', 'archived')",
  "coverImageFileId": "string (File ID from Cloud Storage for an optional course cover image, optional)",
  "createdAt": "timestamp (Timestamp of course creation)",
  "updatedAt": "timestamp (Timestamp of last update)"
}
```

This collection stores records of daily check-ins for courses. Each document represents a single check-in event by a user for a specific course on a particular day.

## `check_ins` Collection
```json
{
  "_id": "string (auto-generated by Cloud Database)",
  "userId": "string (OpenID of the user performing the check-in)",
  "courseId": "string (ID of the course this check-in belongs to, from 'courses' collection)",
  "checkInDate": "string (Date of check-in, format: 'YYYY-MM-DD')",
  "notes": "string (Optional notes or journal entry for the check-in, optional)",
  "isLate": "boolean (Indicates if the check-in was for a past due date, optional)",
  "celebrationPlayed": "boolean (Indicates if a celebration animation was shown for this check-in, for client-side logic)",
  "createdAt": "timestamp (Timestamp of check-in record creation)"
}
```

This collection stores all the badges created or earned by users. Each document represents a single badge with its details, image, and associated category.

## `badges` Collection
```json
{
  "_id": "string (auto-generated by Cloud Database)",
  "userId": "string (OpenID of the user who owns the badge)",
  "title": "string (Name/Title of the badge)",
  "description": "string (Optional description of the badge, optional)",
  "categoryId": "string (ID of the category this badge belongs to, from 'badge_categories' collection)",
  "imageFileId": "string (File ID from Cloud Storage for the badge image)",
  "issueDate": "timestamp (Date the badge was acquired or created)",
  "expiryDate": "timestamp (Optional expiry date for the badge, optional)",
  "reminderEnabled": "boolean (Whether reminders are enabled for this badge, default: false)",
  "customProperties": "object (Any other custom fields the user wants to add, e.g., { 'acquiredFrom': 'Event X' }, optional)",
  "createdAt": "timestamp (Timestamp of badge record creation)",
  "updatedAt": "timestamp (Timestamp of last update)"
}
```

This collection stores categories for organizing badges. It includes both default categories provided by the system and custom categories created by users.

## `badge_categories` Collection
```json
{
  "_id": "string (auto-generated by Cloud Database)",
  "userId": "string (OpenID of the user who created the category, null/system for default categories)",
  "name": "string (Name of the category, e.g., 'Certificates', 'Event Mementos', 'Personal Goals')",
  "isDefault": "boolean (True if this is a pre-defined default category, false for user-created ones)",
  "icon": "string (Optional icon identifier or URL for the category, optional)",
  "createdAt": "timestamp (Timestamp of category creation)"
}
```
Example default categories:
- `{ "userId": null, "name": "Academic", "isDefault": true, ... }`
- `{ "userId": null, "name": "Professional", "isDefault": true, ... }`
- `{ "userId": null, "name": "Personal Achievements", "isDefault": true, ... }`

This collection stores records for general-purpose check-ins or logs that are not tied to a specific course. Users can record thoughts, upload photos, audio, or track moods. Each document represents a single such event.

## `general_check_ins` Collection
```json
{
  "_id": "string (auto-generated by Cloud Database)",
  "userId": "string (OpenID of the user performing the check-in)",
  "checkInType": "string (e.g., 'log', 'photo', 'audio', 'mood')",
  "textContent": "string (Text content for 'log' or 'mood' type, optional)",
  "imageFileId": "string (File ID from Cloud Storage for 'photo' type, optional)",
  "audioFileId": "string (File ID from Cloud Storage for 'audio' type, optional)",
  "mood": "string (Specific mood if type is 'mood', e.g., 'happy', 'sad', 'productive', optional)",
  "location": "object (Optional GeoPoint or address string, optional)",
  "tags": "array of strings (User-defined tags for easy filtering, optional)",
  "createdAt": "timestamp (Timestamp of check-in record creation)"
}
```
